verdict.rationale: Orb documents day-based proration that credits customers for the unused portion of the period on plan changes (orb-docs-16). It keeps a complete audit trail of every plan assignment under a stable subscription ID (orb-docs-32), and subscription edits such as seat changes can be previewed for invoice impact before saving (orb-docs-11, orb-docs-31). Invoice calculation docs cover minimums and maximums (orb-docs-20). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of invoice line-item breakdown for prorated credits and charges, rounding and penny-level reconciliation rules, distinct upgrade vs. downgrade handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
